column4: Open failed because of wrong assumptions about the layout of array formulas returning strings
column9: gen:Sheet(FORMULA(0,0,str) REC(ARRAY, u16:0 u16:0 00 00 u16:0 u32:0 u16:3 1E 0100) STRING('abc'))
column12: reported by Rory Campbell-Lange; the first cell of an array formula is followed by its ARRAY record, and only then by the STRING record holding the text result ([MS-XLS] 2.4.127 Formula, 2.4.268 String)

column4: A BIFF8 file missing its CODEPAGE record is read as UTF-16LE
column12: BIFF8 text is Unicode ([MS-XLS] 2.5.293 XLUnicodeRichExtendedString), so no CODEPAGE is needed

column4: Older files missing a CODEPAGE record raise an exception; the encoding_override argument names the encoding
column12: API: encoding_override, which Bodu does not have; xlrd stopped raising in 0.6.1a5 and Bodu reads such a file in Windows-1252 (the 0.6.1a5 and 2.0.0 rows)

column4: Further work on parsing number formats: the General_) format
column12: Chris Withers' example: General followed by a spacing token is not a date

column4: Reliance on DIMENSIONS and ROW records was abandoned
column12: sample files from John Popplewell and Richard Sharp held cells outside the DIMENSIONS range; Bodu reports the declared range and reads every cell (docs/docs/excel/concepts.md, Used range)

column4: A file size that is not a whole number of OLE sectors is logged instead of raising
column12: the compound file has 100 bytes after its last whole sector, which no chain uses

column4: Gnumeric writes user-defined formats with codes starting at 50 instead of 164
column12: a FORMAT record defining index 50 overrides the built-in CJK date format at that index; its code 0.00 is a number format, not a date

column4: The '_' character in a format is treated like an escape character
column12: an underscore takes the width of the character after it, which is not a field ([MS-XLS] 2.4.126 Format, NumberFormat grammar); the d after it is no day field

column4: An empty formula result means a zero-length string, not an empty cell
column12: [MS-XLS] 2.5.133 FormulaValue: byte 0 = 3 is an empty string result, which Bodu surfaces as a String cell holding the empty string

column4: Gnumeric writes DIMENSIONS with the row and column counts each one too small, and pyXLwriter writes no ROW records
column12: a two-by-two block under a DIMENSIONS record one row and one column short, with no ROW records; every cell must read, and Bodu reports the range as declared

column4: pyXLwriter writes the DIMENSIONS record with the antique opcode 0x0000 instead of 0x0200
column12: xlrd reads 0x0000 as DIMENSIONS; in BIFF5 and BIFF8 DIMENSIONS is 0x0200 ([MS-XLS] 2.4.90), Bodu skips unrecognized records and reports a sheet without DIMENSIONS with the zero-count default (docs/docs/excel/concepts.md, Used range); every cell still reads

column4: A Gnumeric file had zeroes in its DIMENSIONS record but data in cell A1
column12: the declared range is empty but A1 holds a value, which must read
